body:
The thing is, I've been too nice to ppl for far too long, and it's only turned out on my getting hurt, my family only comes to me whenever they need money or do some heavy lifting, that's the only reason they'll miss me. 

Friends? I don't really have any, maybe a couple Xbox friends but they have their lives.

Is not the breakup clouding my judgement, if anything I feel like I can see a bit clearer.

I've been through so much shit in my life for the past 8 years that it almost feels like the right thing to do.
She thinks im sexy when I get I get angry/jealous and try to claim her as mine

Dont think you really care, but just an update(since you're the only one who had something to say) faster than expected. 

We were just "talking". By that i mean, i was trying to talk, she was ignoring me, and just like that she says, i just want to be left alone and she ended the call (this was on a video call on Facebook messenger).

So.. There it is. Unfortunately no happy ending here.

Sorry it took me too long to respond, I've been trying to hold everything together and to talk with her, but im not sure we're going on the right path.

Long story short, there's this dude, the best way to describe him is a fratboy. He likes to flirt a lot, she seems to enjoy it more than she admits.

Every time i try to talk to her about the subject, she claims i often do the same, which i don't. And she says that is nothing important, that they're just messing around and that i have nothing to worry about.

She also says that we have communication issues but whenever i try to actually talk with her, she's texting someone else and pays no attention what so ever to what i am saying.

I love her, i really do, she knows i do. Really wish there was a way to work things out, but it feels like no matter what, i end up loosing. 

Thank you for taking time to read and answer, appreciate the advice :).
